title: Laptop crawling with four gigabytes free

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
The laptop has been painful since I copied the site photos off the camera on
Monday. Everything takes an age to open. Windows is telling me I have about 4GB
left on the C drive, if that is relevant.

I have restarted it twice.

Tom

must_include.what: Free disk space: under 10% on the system drive causes exactly this
Say what to clear: Downloads and the recycle bin

must_not_include.what: Jumps to a hardware refresh, which the runbook puts last and only for old devices
Tells him to restart, which he has already done twice

characteristics: Leads with the number he already gave: 4GB free is the cause, not a symptom
Does not repeat the restart step he has already carried out

rationale: He has supplied the diagnosis without realising it. Step 2 of the runbook is under 10% free on the system drive, and 4GB on a modern laptop is far under. Slow but working, so P3 (G1). The restart step is already done, which is why a reply that opens with it is a wrong answer even though the runbook opens with it - a reply is judged on this ticket, not on the runbook's running order.
